query: I’m evaluating a 79‑year‑old man. In male inpatients aged 74–84 with AKI, what are the cohort’s median risk score (IQR) and 30‑day mortality? Compare ARDS rate and survivor LOS to general male inpatients 74–84 and give the risk percentile.
final_sql: SELECT a.subject_id, a.gender, a.anchor_age, a.anchor_year, a.anchor_year_group, a.diagnosis_code, a.diagnosis_name, a.score, a.risk_category, a.risk_score, a.risk_percentile, b.score AS score_75_85, b.risk_category AS risk_category_75_85, b.risk_score AS risk_score_75_85, b.risk_percentile AS risk_percentile_75_85, c.score AS score_70_75, c.risk_category AS risk_category_70_75, c.risk_score AS risk_score_70_75, c.risk_percentile AS risk_percentile_70_75, d.score AS score_65_70, d.risk_category AS risk_category_65_70, d.risk_score AS risk_score_65_70, d.risk_percentile AS risk_percentile_65_70 FROM a JOIN b ON a.subject_id = b.subject_id JOIN c ON a.subject_id = c.subject_id JOIN d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE a.score > 75 AND a.score < 85 AND b.score > 70 AND b.score < 75 AND c.score > 70 AND c.score < 75 AND d.score > 65 AND d.score < 70;
